title: The explicit Koszul comparison is compatible with every derived representative
statement: Let X, A, d, r, a, C, the explicit small ringed site O, derived equivalence F and scalar sections b be as in [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion, def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete, def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. For every complex P of O-modules and a specified isomorphism realization : Q P ≅ F(Q C), put T = ringedKoszulTensorTowerComplex O r b P [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system]. There is an isomorphism e : F(Q intrinsicCompletionComplex(C)) ≅ Q(roosF(T)) [def-weil-strict-roos-model] carrying F(Q intrinsicCompletionComplexUnit(C)) to realization.inv followed by Q(ringedKoszulLimitUnit(P) followed by the inverse canonical termwise-limit comparison followed by roosι(T)). This compares two explicitly specified product fibers and their zero-homotopy units. It concludes no total-derived inverse-limit, Cech, idempotence, completeness or reflection assertion. The finite list may be empty; no generation assumption is imposed.

proof.text: The naturality of the total-tensor right unitor and whisker exchange prove naturality in the input of the maps into the Koszul levels. Compose with ordinary-limit projections to prove the limit-unit naturality. The inverse canonical termwise-limit natural isomorphism and roosInclusion make the actual zero-homotopy Roos unit a natural transformation.

Transfer exact countable products along the actual module equivalence and apply strictRoosDerivation to get RF and kappa. Use only the tensorTower and tensorFactors fields of the presentation D supplied by the existing single-site Cech--Koszul theorem. These factor the actual tensor/Roos functor through localization. Localization.liftNatTrans descends its actual unit; its component formula identifies the unit on every localized complex. Naturality of this lifted transformation under any supplied representative isomorphism gives a unit-compatible isomorphism between the corresponding localized Roos fibers.

Apply the source explicit chain isomorphism at the actual termwise transported complex N. Compose its localization with the exact module functor localization factorization and with the representative isomorphism from the preceding step. Naturality of the same factorization carries the source completion unit to the actual Roos unit. Cancel its inverse and hom at the input C; exactly realization.inv remains. This also applies to empty lists, zero rings and zero complexes.

theorem completed_fiber_roos_comparison
    (X : Scheme.{v}) {A : Type (v + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (C : CochainComplex (pbcModules X (pbcAdicCompletion X d)) ℤ) :
    let O := completedCechRing X d
    let F := completedCechDerivedEquiv X d
    let b := fun i ↦ completedCechScalar X d (a i)
    ∀ (P : ringedSiteComplex O)
      (realization : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ F.functor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)),
      let T := ringedKoszulTensorTowerComplex O r b P
      ∃ e : F.functor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (intrinsicCompletionComplex X d r a C)) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj (roosF.obj T),
        F.functor.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map (intrinsicCompletionComplexUnit X d r a C)) ≫
            e.hom = realization.inv ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (ringedKoszulLimitUnit O r b P ≫
            (completedKoszulTermwiseLimitIso.app T).inv ≫ roosι T)
